entries.text: Hello? This is Saffron.[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_00

entries.text: You have my thanks for inviting so many talented\npeople to Blueberry Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_01

entries.text: I think you’ve earned yourself a special gift![VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_02

entries.text: Let’s see... How about the right to challenge\nthe academy’s [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]secret boss[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to a battle?[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_03

entries.text: Swing by the academy entrance, why don’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_04

entries.text: He’ll be waiting for you there. Anyway, talk to\nyou later![VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_05

entries.text: Huh? Well, hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_06

entries.text: What’re you doing here? Waiting for someone?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.text: Yeah, the secret boss...

entries.text: I was told to come here...

entries.text: Oh, I gotcha![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.text: Well, spoiler alert... As it turns out...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_09

entries.text: Saffron was me! This whole time![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You really breathed life into this academy,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
The clubs, the students—you name it! Everyone’s
having the most fulfilling school life ever![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_11

entries.text: As director, I am sincerely grateful. I take my\nhat off to you.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_12

entries.text: But y’see, I’m not just the director of Blueberry\nAcademy...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_13

entries.text: As the strongest Trainer here, I’m also the secret\nboss of this fine institution![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_14

entries.text: The BB League Champion is what you’d call the\n“main” boss. But it’s more fun if there’s a secret\r\nboss that’s stronger, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_15

entries.text: I think you and I can have a real blast of a battle![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_16

entries.text: No time to waste—let’s get this started.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_17

entries.text: I’m not going to hold back, OK? Try to hang in\nthere![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_18

entries.text:

entries.text: Hold on, though... The BB League Champion just\ndefeated the secret boss, which means...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_20

entries.text: That makes you the...Blueberry King? How do\nyou fancy that name?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.text: That makes you the...Blueberry Queen? How do\nyou fancy that name?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.text: I like the sound of that!
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_select_03

entries.text: Uh, what are my other options?
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_select_04

entries.text: We’ll decide on a proper title later! For now, let\nme offer you my congratulations![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_22

entries.text: I think you deserve a special reward for defeating\nthe secret boss![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_23

entries.text: This is such a splendid occasion, though. I feel\nlike I should give you something more...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_00

entries.text: Oh, I know! How about we trade Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_01

entries.text: I’ll trade my Blitzle—what do you say?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_02

entries.text: Any Pokémon from you is more than welcome to\ncome with me![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
